rateLimits.note: Track Items: "rate limited at 10 requests per minute", up to 10 tracking ids a request. The page does not say per what: per key assumed.

provenance.notes: API Licence Terms of Use (July 2025): use only to facilitate Australia Post services (3.1(e)); eCommerce partners integrating for other customers apply for approval (3.1(f)); the information received may not be reproduced, republished or modified (5.1, 5.2); you answer for those you give credentials to. Shipping & Tracking is for eParcel and StarTrack contract customers. No limit published for shipments. No idempotency key: a shipment can be deleted until it is in an order; it is sent once.
